units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: Let's start with the method that holds this whole body of thought together, syncretism.

units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: Syncretism is the practice of syncing and combining all fields of knowledge into one unified system.

units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: It unites every subject of matter into a single holy science.

units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: The core premise is that all things come from the One, and therefore all things are One.

units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: The world we live in is a fractional world, meaning that from both a micro and a macro perspective, all things contain all things.

units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: Now the average person today is living their life, left hemisphere dominant.

units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: The left hemisphere of the brain takes the right hemisphere, beer united perception of reality and breaks it down into separate fragments so that we can manipulate and understand things logically.

units.lesson: 01 - Syncretism and the Lightwave Universe
units.text: To fully grasp what this material presents, you must first free your mind from the indoctrinations given by the educational systems we were forced to attend, and second, try to perceive reality as one united and holistic creation.

units.text: Then if it is mine, it is not me.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This body is the vehicle for our soul, our entity, to operate within this physical world of time and space.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The reason the Holy Grail is a cup is because the sun and the moon create the holy fluid, the Christ oil, and fill it up every month.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: In Masonic art, this is symbolized as the sun and moon creating the bion milk and honey in the brain.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The milk is the fluid created by the moon, and the honey is the fluid created by the sun.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The pineal gland is associated with the honey, the sun, the male, and the electric.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The pituitary gland is associated with the milk, the moon, the female, and the magnetic.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The Holy Grail is the neck and skull.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: There is a passage from Corinthians 6, 19 to 20.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God?

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: You are not your own, for you were bought with a price, so glorify God in your body.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Glorifying God in your body means raising the chrism, the Christ oil.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Up the spine and looking after the body.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The elites in power have externalized all of the sacred things, like the Holy Grail and the Temple of Solomon.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This is done to keep you from finding out the fact that you are the ultimate of all things, that man is truly created in the image of God.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The Church and other religions teach the masses the exoteric meaning, the external teachings.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This is done purposely to keep the pyramid scheme up and running.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Meanwhile, the people in power get taught the esoteric meaning, the internal teachings about the body, consciousness, and the metaphysical aspects of reality.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The Bible is written in such a way that it will resonate with your level of understanding.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: You can perceive the Bible physically, historically, and metaphorically depending on how wide you have expanded your mind.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Your reality is your level of realization.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Now we move to the planes of existence.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: There are several, and they stack from the most formless to the most solid.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The mental plane is the dimension of the mind.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The mind is a part of the universal mind.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: So the mental plane is shared between all the minds that exist.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: It is the world of thoughts.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Thoughts are not created.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: They are received based upon what frequency our mind is set to.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This is why we call it a mindset.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Each thought, topic, and subject is a frequency, and when you set your mind to these topics, you gain the thoughts that are on that similar frequency.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The world of thought is completely formless.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: It is the most fluidic plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The astral plane is where thoughts manifest into forms.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: For example, the mental plane is the thought of a chair, and the astral plane is the imagination of that chair.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: It is basically the world of imagination and mental pictures.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The screen we see in our mind when we imagine something is the astral plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: We create with our thoughts.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This is why thoughts are things.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The astral plane is created out of thoughts manifesting, and each thought has a vibrational frequency.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This results in generating three main levels, higher, middle, and lower, depending on the vibrational frequency of the thought.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The manifesting thought form will appear on the higher, middle, or lower astral plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The higher planes embody high vibrational thoughts like love and joy, and the lower planes will be demonic thoughts like hate, murder, and lust.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: When we astral project, we are using our mind to project the soul into the astral plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: You will only see and encounter beings that are on a similar frequency as you.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: If you operate on a low frequency, you will come across demons and negative entities.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Diamonds, angels, spirits, and jinn are living within the astral plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: They are, basically, entities that have no physical body.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Elementals are spirits of the four elements.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: For example, there are spirits of fire, water, earth, and air.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The etheric plane is the world of energy, electricity, and magnetism.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: It is the fifth element, also known as spirit or aether.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The aether is a substance that has one foot in the physical world and one foot in the astral world.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Aether is where we get the word either.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Either is connecting two scenarios in language, for example.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: I either support Manchester, United, or Liverpool.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The ether is the same thing, connecting two planes together.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The word body together has the word either within it.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: It is joining two planes.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: There are also aetheric entities that live amongst us, like goblins, gnomes, and trolls.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: They are entities that have the ability to materialize or stay in the astral body at their will.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: They can choose whether to be physical or non-physical.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This is where we get the myths of trolls, fairies, gnomes, and goblins from.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: They are very secretive beings and do not like to be seen by humans.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The physical plane is the world of matter.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: It is the world governed by the five elements.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: It is the world of effect.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Everything we experience and visually see with the two eyes is the effect of the higher planes above.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This is where we get the saying, Oz above, so below.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: You change the higher planes of existence, and you change the physical plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: This is why magic is indeed real.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Magicians and occultists do have methods to have contact with these astral and etheric entities, which then have the ability to manipulate the physical plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Leonardo da Vinci is symbolizing, as above, so below.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Look up, because that is the root cause.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: There is no point in looking down here, because the physical plane is the world of effect.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Whatever you see and experience is the effect of your mind.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: So look up at the cause.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Change your mind and you change your reality.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: As within, so without.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The planes stack in this order.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The mental plane at the top.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Then the higher astral.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The middle astral.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The lower astral.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: Then the etheric and the physical at the bottom.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: And the stars are not physical places.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: They are portals to the astral plane.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: The stars are the start of the soul system.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: We are a star wrapped in flesh.

units.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
units.text: A fallen angel of light.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Let's start with the structure of reality itself.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: There are different levels of reality and they are not separate from one another.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Each plane melts into the plane above and below it.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: In other words, every plane is a product of the plane that is above it.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The higher you go, the more fluid and formless the plane becomes.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The lower you go, the more material and solid it becomes.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: This is why the two Masonic pillars appear so often in Masonic artwork.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Those two pillars symbolize the number 11 and the number 11 is the mirroring of realities within the planes of existence.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Whatever you do in the astral plane will manifest into the physical world.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It is like a mirror.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The ethereal plane is in constant rotation with the physical plane and that rotation happens through rhyme, karma, polarity and gender.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The circle is never-ending.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It has no beginning and no end.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It is eternal and it is the expansiveness of all things.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Now before you attempt astral projection, you need to understand what the astral plane actually is.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The astral plane is the fourth dimension.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It is the way thought forms exist, meaning mental images.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It can be seen only by our mind, D and I.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When you project, you will experience beings and entities that match your frequency.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: So you should make sure you are vibrating as high as possible before trying to project.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Everything you think of will manifest instantly in the astral plane.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: In the fourth dimension, your vision in the astral plane will not be very clear when you first project.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: You have to work on strengthening it.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The ideas we mentally entertain can take form in the fourth dimensional plane.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: If you entertain negative thought forms for long periods, the emotional power you give that thought can manifest into a Diamon.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Every single mental addiction you have is some Diamon you created within the astral plane.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It grows the more emotion you give it, and emotion is energy in motion.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The word Diamon has the letters M-O-N in it, which means moon.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Moon is mind.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: We create demons.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: With our mind is the projector of your soul.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Your soul is the experiencer, the observer.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When you astral project, you are using your mind to project the soul out of the physical body, out of the physical world, into the astral plane where there are no limitations of time and space.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When you dream, your mind is projecting the soul into another reality, while the physical body is resting.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Here is the practice for astral projection.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Lie down flat, with no body parts touching, rest every single muscle, and be as still as possible close your eyes.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Breathe deep in through the nose and slowly out the mouth.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Meditate until you have lost all desires and the mind is empty of thoughts.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Then focus your attention on the middle of your brain on the pineal gland.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Do this until you start to feel a tingling sensation all over the body.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The tingling sensation is your energy, body, your etheric body being awakened.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Now imagine yourself pulling a rope up into the sky.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: You may feel yourself being lifted out of the body.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Do not be scared.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Keep doing this exercise until you gain the ability to leave the whole body and discover the astral plane.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: If you do astral projects successfully and you feel as if you want to enter back into your physical body, all you have to do is think about going to your body and you will be shot back into your body.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: This is where the story of Jesus walking on water comes in.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Jesus never walked on water.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It is symbolic for leaving the physical body.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The water is the ethereal plane, which is the veil between the physical world and the astral world.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Jesus was walking on top of the veil of the ether, meaning he was astral projecting.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When Jesus teaches Peter to walk on water, he is teaching him not to be scared, or else you will fall back into the water.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: This is symbolic of when you are astral projecting.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When you start to fear while projecting, you will be sucked back into your body.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: That is the meaning of Matthew 14 29 where Peter, beginning to sink, cries out, Lord save me.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Now let us move to the chakras.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The word chakra in Sanskrit means wheel.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The chakras are seven wheels of energy that are a part of the electromagnetic field we call our aura.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The chakras are like mini brains.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Pulling all the cells and organs within that section of the body, the seven chakras are the seven seals in the Bible.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The chakras are a part of the etheric body, as they are seven seals that bind your soul and spirit to the physical body.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The lowest chakra, the root chakra, is the most dense and physical, and the highest, the crown.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Chakra is spirit and formless.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: We descended from spirit into matter.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Now we have to return to our spirit self in the crown chakra.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The crown chakra is located just above the head, out of the body, because it is pure spirit.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Our true God self is hidden behind the seven chakras, as the chakras can be abused or balanced.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When we balance the vices of the chakras, we build a strong mind and soul connection which then manifests into our external world.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When the mind and body manifest the solely, the higher self, ideas 24 7th, we become our true God self, and there are no mental or etheric blockages within our different bodies of consciousness.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: There are actually seven vowels, and each vowel corresponds with one of the chakras.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: When chanting the vowels correctly, it creates the phonetic sound of OM, OM is known as the sound of creation.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: And when we say it, we are aligning the seven creational energies within our etheric body.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Each chakra vibrates on a different frequency, and you can listen to these frequencies to help balance each chakra.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The ether is the fifth element, also known as spirit.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: It is a substance that has one foot in the astral plane and one foot in the physical plane.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The ether is the word either because it is on either side.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The chakras are on the etheric plane, and when we unlock these centers, we unlock our true spirit form.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: There is a numerical structure to the chakras that connects to the 144,000 faithful Christians.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Jehovah Witnesses believe exactly 144,000 faithful Christians will go to heaven.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: This is a frequency you need to achieve in order to go from the root to the crown.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Chakra and head is heaven.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Here is how the numbers work.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Add the first five petals.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The root has four petals, the sacral has six, the solar has ten, the heart has twelve, and the throat has sixteen.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Add those first five.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Four plus six plus ten plus twelve equals forty-eight.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The third eye has two petals, forty-eight times two equals ninety-six.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: Ninety-six plus forty-eight equals one hundred and forty-four.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The crown has ten hundred petals, ten hundred times one hundred and forty-four equals one hundred forty-four thousand hertz.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: That is, each chakra also corresponds to a set of qualities.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The root chakra is grounding and survival.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The sacral is sexuality and creativity.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The solar plexus is power and self-love.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The heart is love and inner peace.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The throat is communication and self-expression.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self
units.text: The third eye is intuition and psychic ability.

units.lesson: 05 - Astral Plane, Chakras, and the True Self

adjudication.coverage_verdict: Near-complete. The eight lessons carry essentially the whole doctrinal payload of the source — syncretism, the lightwave/Walter Russell material, hue/human, the Christ-oil process step by step, the biblical geography of the body, the pineal gland, the Holy Grail, the four/five planes, astral projection technique, the chakra system (including the hand and foot chakras and the 144,000 petal arithmetic), the hemispheres, 440Hz/Rockefeller, the ether/elements, the electromagnetic-earth and firmament/flat-earth cosmology. What drops out is mostly front matter and a handful of one-line decodings buried in image captions.

missing_from_course.source_fact: The entire front matter: 'AUTHOR - HARRY B JOSEPH (REVIVAL OF WISDOM)', the title 'THE BOOK OF WISDOM', registration with the UK Copyright Service, and the warning that marketing or re-sale without consent invites legal action.
missing_from_course.why_it_matters: The listener is never told whose work this is, what it is called, or that it is a self-published copyrighted book. The course presents the doctrine as free-floating authority with no attribution or provenance.

missing_from_course.source_fact: 'ALL OF THE IMAGES IN THIS BOOK HAVE BEEN EDITED, MANIPULATED, AND ATIFICIALLY GENERATED TO AVOID ANY COPYRIGHT CLAIMS... NOT ONE OF THE IMAGES USED IN THIS BOOK IS BEING USED IN ITS ORIGINAL FORM.'
missing_from_course.why_it_matters: The lessons repeatedly appeal to images as evidence ('Notice the lamb is looking up at a cup', 'There is an image of Horus and Set', 'Hitler used two flat earth maps'). The source itself admits every one of those images was edited or AI-generated. Omitting that disclosure materially changes how a listener weighs the visual 'evidence'.

missing_from_course.source_fact: 'THREE WISE MEN FROM THE EAST' = 1. THALAMUS 2. PINEAL GLAND 3. PITUITARY GLAND.
missing_from_course.why_it_matters: This is a discrete scripture-to-anatomy decoding of exactly the kind the course otherwise reproduces exhaustively. It vanishes entirely, even though the thalamus appears elsewhere in Lesson 3 as the 'cross' of the crucifixion.

missing_from_course.source_fact: 'ASTRONOMY / ASTRO=ASTRAL / SPACE IS FAKE' and the 'MENTALISM / CORRESPONDANCE / ENERGY' hermetic labels attached to the planes diagram.
missing_from_course.why_it_matters: 'Space is fake' is the source's blunt statement of its cosmological position and the etymological bridge (astronomy = astral) that justifies calling stars 'portals'. Lesson 4 keeps only the softened 'the stars are not physical places. They are portals to the astral plane', so the load-bearing premise is dropped.

missing_from_course.source_fact: 'SIN IN LATIN IS SINISTER MEANS LEFT / RIGHT = RIGHTIOUS'.
missing_from_course.why_it_matters: Lesson 6 keeps only half of it — 'In Latin, and right is righteous' — dropping the left-brain=sin=sinister half, which is the whole point of the pairing and the source's moral framing of left-hemisphere dominance.

missing_from_course.source_fact: The 'S P IN E / SPIN E' wordplay, and the Vishnu–Brahma–Shiva mapping onto soul/mind/body.
missing_from_course.why_it_matters: Lesson 3 salvages only 'The soul, which is Brahma, has multiple faces'; the trimurti-to-triad correspondence and one of the source's characteristic word-splits are lost, weakening the 'all is one' syncretic demonstration the course opens with.

fabrications.lesson: 02 - Christ Oil, Brain Anatomy, and Kundalini
fabrications.explanation: The source has a stray caption 'JORDAN RIVER' next to the word 'HEAVEN' from an adjacent block. The source states unambiguously and repeatedly that 'RIVER JORDAN = SPINAL CORD' — the head is heaven. The audio's sentence directly contradicts the source's own mapping, and Lesson 2 states the correct mapping ('The River Jordan is the spinal cord') only a few sentences earlier, so the listener gets two incompatible claims.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'The head corresponds to the mind, the heart to the body, and the heel to the soul.'
fabrications.lesson: 06 - Chakra Balance, Head as Heaven, and Hemispheres
fabrications.explanation: The source's three-brain table reads: HEAVEN/HEAD = MENTAL = MIND = GOD; EARTH/HEART = EMOTIONAL = SOUL = JESUS; HELL/HEEL = PHYSICAL = BODY = SATAN. The audio swaps soul and body, so the heel becomes the soul and the heart becomes the body — the exact inversion of a mapping the rest of the course depends on (the heel is elsewhere called the most physical, root-chakra, 'hell' position).

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'Consciousness is referenced in Chronicles 3 10, and the 33 vertebrae appear again in this context.'
fabrications.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes

The '33 VERDABREA' text nearby is an unrelated floating image label. The audio invents a scriptural link between Chronicles and the vertebrae that the source never makes.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'The gland connects to the body through specific pathways, the retino-hypothalamic tract, the suprachiasmatic nucleus, the superior cervical ganglion... These are the physical roots by which light information reaches the gland.'

The explanatory sentence describing them as a light-information pathway is neuroanatomy imported from outside the letter and delivered as if it were the source's teaching.

fabrications.explanation: The source's I KNOW / I SEE / I SPEAK / I LOVE / I DO / I FEEL / I AM column carries no gender-polarity claim. The masculine/feminine polarity in the source belongs to the hand chakras (ring and little fingers feminine, thumb and index masculine). The audio transplants it onto the spinal chakras.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'The head is associated with concentration and meditation, the masculine Solar Yang principle. The heel is associated with contemplation. The Feminine Lunar Yin principle.'
fabrications.lesson: 06 - Chakra Balance, Head as Heaven, and Hemispheres
fabrications.explanation: The source has an unstructured caption cluster: 'concentration contemplation meditation / HEAD HEAVEN / masculine femanine solar lunar yang yin / HEEL HELL'. No assignment of concentration or meditation to the head, or contemplation to the heel, is made. The course manufactures a correspondence table out of adjacent words.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'The Christ oil is named for the 33 years of Christ and the spine has 33 vertebrae.'
fabrications.lesson: 03 - Born Again, the Serpent, and the Tree of Life
fabrications.explanation: The source reverses this causality — '33 VERDABREAS FOR THE 33 YEARS OF CHRIST' and 'CHRISTOS=GREEK FOR OIL. THEN IT BECAME CHRIST'. In the source the oil is named from the Greek christos and the age 33 derives from the vertebrae; the audio has the oil named from the age, inverting the etymological argument the course itself repeats elsewhere.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'The medical symbol of two serpents, wrapped around the staff, is also this.'
fabrications.lesson: 03 - Born Again, the Serpent, and the Tree of Life
fabrications.explanation: The source says the two serpents are 'WRAPED AROUND THE SPINE' and never mentions a staff or caduceus. The staff is imported general knowledge, and it slightly undercuts the source's point that the central column is the spine, not a rod.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'There is a quote from Walter Russell Lee, Universal One'; 'In Genesis 1 to 3, it says, Ben, let there be light'; 'Matthew 6 22 says, Abbas the light of the body is the eye'; 'John 21 to 6 says, bottle cast the net on the right-hand side'.
fabrications.explanation: 'Universal One by Walter Russell' has been mangled into a person named 'Walter Russell Lee', and quotation openers have been rendered as nonsense words ('Ben', 'Abbas', 'bottle', 'bar'). The surrounding sentences track the source verbatim, so these are delivery/STT corruption rather than authoring errors — but they make citations unusable to a listener.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'the quaestrum is Santa Claus' (L2); 'manifest into a Diamon... The word Diamon has the letters M-O-N in it' (L5); 'And note that Amel means God' (L6); 'the Egyptians stated, all is a two, meaning all is Adam, the Taurus field' (L6); 'The Egyptian Jedpila'; 'Neo Tollos from The Matrix'; 'The Rockefeller Foundation, in the 1950 seconds'; 'Deuteronomy 2017'; 'The crown has ten hundred petals'.
fabrications.explanation: Each of these tracks the source exactly (claustrum, daemon, EL=GOD, 'ALL IS ATUM... ALL IS ATOM, THE TORUS FIELD', Djed pillar, Neo, 1950s, Deuteronomy 20:17, crown=1000 petals) but is phonetically corrupted. Several destroy the very wordplay being taught — 'Amel means God' kills the EL=GOD decoding, and 'all is a two... Adam, the Taurus field' kills the Atum/atom/torus pun, which is the entire point of that passage.

fabrications.claim_in_audio: 'the word body together has the word either within it. It is joining two planes.'
fabrications.lesson: 04 - Pineal Gland, Holy Grail, and the Planes
fabrications.explanation: The source reads 'THE WORD TOGETHER HAS THE WORD ETHER WITHIN IT.' The inserted 'body' and the substitution of 'either' for 'ether' break the etymological demonstration — 'together' does not contain 'either'.

redundancy.repeated_content: The full Christ-oil narrative: oil descends the spine, rests 3 days on the sacrum ('the cave'), kundalini raises it past the 33 vertebrae, crosses the vagus nerve = crucifixion at 33, matter turns to spirit.
redundancy.lessons: 02 (opening and again in the step list), 03 (twice — once at the top under John 3:3, once again in full under 'the alchemical process that occurs monthly')
redundancy.note: The source itself states this three times, so some duplication is inherited. But the course reproduces all of it rather than consolidating: Lesson 3 tells the same story twice within itself, and the second telling adds only the optic-thalamus-as-cross detail. Roughly four full retellings of one narrative across two lessons. One canonical telling plus a one-line callback for the thalamus variant would have carried the same content.

redundancy.repeated_content: 'Head is heaven, same root word HEA' / 'Head and heaven are the same root words' / 'The head is heaven because it is the place of consciousness in the center of the brain.'
redundancy.note: This is the course's thesis, so recurrence is defensible, but it is asserted near-verbatim at least six times with no development. By Lesson 8 ('This is why your head is heaven') it adds nothing a listener has not already heard five times.

redundancy.repeated_content: 'Thoughts are not created; they are received based upon what frequency our mind is set to. This is why we call it a mindset.'
redundancy.lessons: 01, 04, and echoed in 06 ('Your mind sets itself to various frequencies')
redundancy.note: The source states this twice itself (under HUMAN and under MENTAL PLANE), and the Lesson 4 restatement genuinely does different work — it is establishing the mental plane rather than the nature of the mind. Acceptable spaced repetition.

redundancy.repeated_content: 'Ether is where we get the word either' / 'the ether has one foot in the physical world and one foot in the astral'.
redundancy.note: Three near-identical statements of a single etymological gag. Lesson 7 opens with it again as if new ('In fact, the word aether is literally the word either'), which is padding given Lesson 4 already ran the Manchester United example.
This is a dense multi-term correspondence table and the three passes serve different frames (the oil process, the sun/moon principles, the Holy Grail). Reinforcement here is pedagogically sound.

redundancy.repeated_content: Earth is an anagram for heart; earth is the heart/middle of the soul system; the balanced realm of good and evil.
redundancy.note: Lesson 7 makes the anagram point, then makes it again verbatim ~1,000 words later, then Lesson 8 makes it a third time ('This could be why earth is an anagram for heart'). The source repeats it too, but the course had the option to fold the second and third instances into the first.

redundancy.repeated_content: Left/right hemisphere functions — analytic fragmentation vs. unified holistic perception, masculine/feminine, ego/intuition.
redundancy.lessons: 01 (intro), 06 (three passes: the short version, the 'let us get precise' version, and the side-by-side scientist/artist list)
redundancy.note: Lesson 6 covers the hemispheres, then announces 'Now let it get precise about how the two hemispheres actually work together' and repeats most of it, then reads out the two-column list a third time. This is faithful to the source's own duplication but produces a fatiguing block inside an already overlong lesson.

redundancy.repeated_content: Astral projection mechanism — 'using our mind to project the soul into the astral plane', frequency-matched entities.
redundancy.note: Lesson 4 states it in passing while defining the astral plane; Lesson 5 develops it into the actual practice. Legitimate setup-and-payoff.

teachability.verdict: Serviceable but front-loaded and badly unbalanced. The material is grouped sensibly and the sequencing is defensible, but Lesson 6 collapses into a grab-bag and Lesson 8 is little more than a read-out of image captions.
strengths: The course imposes a real structure on a document that has none. The source is an OCR'd jumble in which caption text, body text and marginalia interleave mid-sentence; the lessons untangle this into method (01), core mechanism (02), scriptural decodings (03), anatomy and planes (04), practice (05), chakra system (06), cosmology (07-08).

The Christ-oil process is taught as a genuinely followable seven-step sequence — 'First the claustrum... Second, the pineal gland electrically charges the fluid... Third, the pituitary gland magnetically charges the fluid' — which is clearer than the source's interleaved column layout.

Explicit callbacks orient the listener: 'We already talked about the Christ oil as the sacred brain oil and how raising it through the spine awakens the chakras'; 'We've already worked through what the chakras are, how they relate to the etheric body, and how they function as the seven seals.'

Practical instructions are preserved as usable procedure — the astral projection sequence ('Lie down flat, with no body parts touching... focus your attention on the middle of your brain on the pineal gland... imagine yourself pulling a rope up into the sky') and the seven-item 'how to raise the oil' list survive intact and in order.

Lesson 3 closes with a genuine synthesis rather than a stop: 'The spine is the ladder. The brain is heaven. The heart is the tree of life and the nervous system is the tree of knowledge. You are the temple.'
weaknesses: Lesson 6 is grossly oversized — it runs from unbalanced chakras through Baphomet, fast-food colours, the Dispenza emotion chart, hand chakras, foot chakras, the three brains, the hemispheres, 440Hz, Merkaba, Hebrew letters, Corinthians and the Matrix. There is no through-line a listener can hold; it reads as everything that did not fit elsewhere.

Lesson 8 barely teaches. It is a recitation of image captions — 'Therein also the alchemical symbol for earth and the solar and lunar symbols. The masonic compass is an eight-pointed star' — with no explanation of what any of it means. A listener with no picture in front of them gets nothing.

Transcript degradation destroys several of the mnemonics the course exists to convey. The chakra affirmations come out as 'The root is, but I. The sacral is. I feel the solar plexus. I do the heart, idzu. I love the throat. I, spene' — unusable. 'Amel means God' and 'all is a two, meaning all is Adam, the Taurus field' break the two word-puzzles they are supposed to demonstrate.
Filler tics ('Let them pick up where we left off', 'That 10', 'that in why', 'It ta', 'thatian') recur constantly and erode comprehension at exactly the points where the source is making a claim.

Ordering inside lessons sometimes fights the content. Lesson 2 gives the full crucifixion metaphor at the top, then the seven-step oil process, then circles back to the timing trigger ('When the moon enters your sun sign') that logically starts the whole cycle — the listener learns the ending before the beginning.

The course never tells the listener what the source actually is: a self-published illustrated book of annotated images. Caption fragments are therefore delivered in the same assertive register as body text, so a listener cannot tell a developed argument from a stray label — which is precisely how errors like 'The Jordan River is heaven' and the Chronicles/33-vertebrae link got in.

adjudication.bottom_line: Coverage is high — roughly 90% of the source's substantive claims survive, and the course does real work turning an unstructured OCR dump into an ordered curriculum. The losses are the front matter (author, title, copyright) and the image disclaimer, plus a few caption-level decodings ('three wise men' = thalamus/pineal/pituitary, 'space is fake', sin=sinister=left). The fabrication count is low for a document this chaotic, but three findings are substantive rather than cosmetic: 'The Jordan River is heaven' contradicts the source's own mapping, the head/heart/heel triad has soul and body swapped, and Chronicles 3:10 is falsely linked to the 33 vertebrae — all three caused by reading floating image labels as prose. Two smaller insertions import outside anatomy (the retinohypothalamic 'light information' gloss, the caduceus staff). Repetition is the main structural flaw: the Christ-oil narrative is told about four times across Lessons 2-3, 'head is heaven' six times, and the ether/either pun three times — some inherited from the source, but the course chose not to consolidate. Fix the three misreadings, restore the authorship and image-manipulation disclosures, split Lesson 6, and give Lesson 8 actual explanatory content rather than a caption list.
